title: Patterns from simplicity
description: Follow a few local rules as they turn into living forms.

stops.note: A grid follows one small rule. Give it time, and repetition begins to make structure.
Two virtual chemicals spread and react; a narrow balance lets patterns hold their shape.
A rewriting grammar grows a sentence. A drawing turtle turns its repeated symbols into branches.
Now simple organisms spend energy, seek food and inherit small variations. The population becomes the pattern.
Each bird responds only to nearby neighbours. The flock’s larger movement has no conductor.

title: The invisible forces
description: Trace how a field changes motion, waves and the path of light.

stops.note: Every mass pulls on every other mass. Move one body and the whole orbital system responds.
Charge is the source; field lines and potential reveal how another charge would be pushed or pulled.
A disturbance travels through a field, then meets its own echoes at boundaries and openings.
At a surface, geometry and material decide whether a ray bends, reflects or stays inside.
Near a black hole, gravity can curve a photon’s path until it escapes or is captured.

title: How machines think
description: Build from a switch to a complete machine, then let connections learn.

stops.note: Start with gates: simple truth rules turn high and low signals into a useful circuit.
The same gates add binary numbers. Follow each bit and watch a carry move through the machine.
A stored program gives circuits a sequence: fetch an instruction, decode it, then move data.
A neural network changes the strengths of its connections until examples shape a decision boundary.

title: Information in motion
description: From a travelling wave to a message finding its way across a network.

stops.note: A signal moves through space as a wave, carrying phase and energy from one place to another.
Sound is periodic motion you can hear. Add harmonics and see how their mixture changes its shape.
Digital circuits encode information as distinct states and transform it one operation at a time.
Packets carry a message from node to node, meeting delay, congestion and broken links along the way.
